title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Training Questions: Credit Balances and Their Refund
content:
**What is a credit balance on a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account?** The negative current balance left when payments and credits exceed the amount owed.

**What happens when the cardmember asks for a refund?** The request is recorded as a card service request for a credit balance refund. The whole credit balance is refunded within the card's credit balance refund business days of the request when it is at least the card's smallest refund on request.

**What must the account show?** The account carries a credit balance of at least the card's smallest refund on request on the request date, as the account record shows.

**Is a request always needed?** No. A credit balance that has remained on the account for the card's number of months is refunded without a request.

**How is the refund made?** By check to the mailing address on file, unless the cardmember asks for a transfer to the bank account on file. It is booked as a credit balance refund that brings the balance back to 0.00.

**In which account statuses?** In every account status, including closed and charged-off.

**Can the credit balance go to a gift card or another card?** No; a credit balance is never moved to a gift card or to another card account.

## Illustrations (hypothetical balances; smallest refund on request USD 1.00)

| Current balance on the request date | Refund on request |
|---|---|
| a credit of USD 64.20 | the whole USD 64.20, by check unless the transfer to the bank account on file is asked for |
| a credit of USD 0.60 | below the smallest refund on request |
| USD 0.00 or an amount owed | no credit balance to refund |
